_comment: Direction SETTLED: stay on ModernUO, port ServUO content in as an ongoing backlog. Only Foundation has a denominator; the content backlog is open-ended by design.

ported_content.name: PlagueRat
ported_content.note: P1 reference port. 88 lines to 55. Builds, spawns, survives save/reload. No speed override: SpeedClass Medium, per the Q-008 answer (ModernUO's npc-speeds.json fallback is the standing rule for all ported creatures).

ported_content.name: GreaterPoisonElemental
ported_content.note: P2 timed port, headless. 123 lines to 80. Compiles clean, server starts, world saves and reloads; type registration proven by reflection over the shipped assembly. Adds PackItem, multi-AddLoot, an OnDeath override, AI_Mage and the two-argument stat overloads over what PlagueRat covered. No speed override, per Q-008. An instance in a saved world is NOT verified: headless has no spawn - batched for a later client spot check.

ported_content.name: LuckyCoin
ported_content.note: Forced dependency of GreaterPoisonElemental; ModernUO has no LuckyCoin. Ported complete except its OnDoubleClick, which needs FountainOfFortune (an SA addon ModernUO lacks that drags in four more items). Deviation is in the item, not the creature. Q-010. Reused by 12 Mobiles/Normal creatures.

ported_content.name: PerfectBanana

ported_content.name: RaptorClaw

Only IsArtifact dropped: it is a ServUO-only Server.Item virtual whose every consumer (pigments, NaturalDye, AlterItem, RunicReforging) is also ServUO-only, so it has zero readers in ModernUO.

ported_content.name: StretchedDinosaurHide
ported_content.note: One of six TOL tribal reward decorations split out of a single ServUO file, one type per file. ported_content.name: Allosaurus
ported_content.note: Three SetWeaponAbility calls become one GetWeaponAbility() over Utility.Random(3). GenerateLoot's IsChampionSpawn branch collapses to the non-champion arm and SetToChampionSpawn is dropped: ModernUO's BaseCreature has neither, and its ChampionSpawn never calls back into the creature. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: Archaeosaurus

ported_content.name: Dimetrosaur
ported_content.note: SetWeaponAbility x2 become GetWeaponAbility(). Two behaviours dropped with no ModernUO equivalent: SetAreaEffect(AreaEffect.PoisonBreath), and OnAfterTame, which quartered Hits on first tame - StatLossAfterTame gives AnimalTaming's ScaleStats(0.50) instead. FruitsAndVegies -> FruitsAndVeggies. AttacksFocus and the champion-spawn hooks dropped.

ported_content.name: Najasaurus
ported_content.note: Clean. Its only PetTrainingHelper call is in the version-0 deserialize upgrade path, which new content at version 0 never runs, and the constructor already sets Poisoning skill and HitPoison - so dropping it is a no-op. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: Saurosaurus
ported_content.note: SetWeaponAbility(ConcussionBlow) becomes GetWeaponAbility(). DragonBlood => 8 dropped. AttacksFocus dropped.

ported_content.name: SilverbackGorilla
ported_content.note: The only candidate creature calling no PetTrainingHelper method. Banana-throw OnActionCombat ported intact: the 13-argument MovingParticles overload with EffectLayer, AOS.Damage and Region.IsPartOf(string) all exist unchanged. DateTime.UtcNow -> Core.Now.

ported_content.name: Raptor
ported_content.note: The only ported creature with real persisted state: m_IsFriend becomes [SerializableField(0, setter: "private")] and ServUO's delete-on-deserialize becomes [AfterDeserialization(false)]. The Raptor()/Raptor(bool) Constructable pair collapses to one [Constructible] Raptor(bool isFriend = false). Pack-friend spawn timer, PackInstinct.Ostard, Map.CanFit and AIObject.Action all port unchanged. SetWeaponAbility(BleedAttack) becomes GetWeaponAbility(). Drops AncientPotteryFragments and RaptorClaw, both ported alongside.

ported_content.name: Eodon core content (17 files)
ported_content.source: ServUO Time Of Legends, Mobiles/Normal, Items/*
ported_content.note: Six dinosaurs, Raptor, RaptorClaw, RaptorTeeth, six TOL decorations, PerfectBanana, AncientPotteryFragments. Four build batches, zero failures. All 17 types verified registered by reflection over the shipped assembly. Deviations logged in docs/fidelity-principle.md.

declined_content.name: Vice vs Virtue, City Loyalty, Skill Masteries, Exploring the Deep
declined_content.reason: 29-100% dependent on subsystems ModernUO lacks entirely. Deferred to workstream 4.

declined_content.name: Eodon: the eight Aloron armour pieces
declined_content.reason: CC3. Rest on the armour set-bonus subsystem, which ModernUO ships zero files for - SetItem, SetAttributes and AbsorptionAttributes are all absent, and BaseArmor has no SetID/Pieces/Set*Bonus/SetSelfRepair. After the resistances the entire item IS set data, so porting without the subsystem leaves a re-hued TigerPeltChest with a label. They also inherit from the TigerPelt set, a further 8 files. Cost to do properly: the set-bonus subsystem, then TigerPelt (8), then Aloron (8).

declined_content.name: Eodon: the Valley of One quest line
declined_content.reason: CC3. Two reasons, either sufficient. (1) It is 3 of 8 files, not 3 of 3: the directory is 3,870 lines and the three named files reference PrideOfTheAmbushQuest and TimeIsOfTheEssenceQuest from Quests.cs, so they do not compile alone. The 2,058-line figure sums a set that does not stand up. (2) It rests on ServUO's Mondain's Legacy quest framework - BaseQuest, BaseQuestItem, QuestHelper, QuestChain, MondainQuester, BaseRewardTitleDeed, all absent from ModernUO - which is 6,269 lines before gumps and persistence. ModernUO ships a DIFFERENT quest engine (MLQuest/MLQuestSystem: static definitions plus per-player context, versus ServUO's per-player instantiated BaseQuest objects). Porting means either two serialized quest engines in one world or a reimplementation. Subsystem port, not a content port.

declined_content.name: Eodon: MoonstonePowerGenerator
declined_content.reason: CC3. It is Myrmidex Invasion content, not Eodon. It lives inside Services/Expansions/Time Of Legends/Myrmidex Invasion/, spawns Zipactriotl (the Myrmidex boss) and IgnisFatalis, subclasses DamageableItem (absent from ModernUO), and is referenced only by Myrmidex Invasion/System.cs and the MyrmidexThreat quest. It reached the CC3 list because the keyword moonstone matched and nobody opened the file.
